name: SAM Encoder Feature Extraction
aliases: SAM Encoder Feature Extraction and Cropping
definition: Extraction of semantic features using a pre-trained Vision Transformer (ViT) from SAM, including resolution handling and cropping of padding regions.
summary: SAM Encoder Feature Extraction crops the Segment Anything Model's fixed-resolution output to match the original image's aspect ratio, removing padding artifacts to provide accurate semantic supervision for volume rendering.
